motor_wiring._nguon: Suy ra tu ma nha cung cap chay duoc tren robot that: docs/BLKLab_Balancing_Robot_Code/V1_Balancing_Robot_HC05_JQ6500/V1_...ino, khoi sinh xung dong 570-606, doi chieu voi khoi tu can bang dong 370-373.
_giai_thich: Hai dong co NEMA17 duoc lap DOI XUNG GUONG tren khung. De ca hai cung day robot ve phia truoc, chung phai quay NGUOC CHIEU nhau trong khong gian.
Vi vay hai chan DIR PHAI o MUC NGUOC NHAU cho cung mot chieu di.
Dat ca hai chan DIR cung mot muc se lam robot XOAY TAI CHO thay vi tien - ma van bien dich sach va van co xung ra du hai chan STEP.
Day la loai loi ma so do nguyen ly KHONG the cho biet: schematic chi ve day noi, khong ve chieu lap dong co.
motor_wiring._can_xac_nhan: Nap firmware len robot that, cho di toi, nhin hai banh. Neu chung quay nguoc nhau thi dao lai hai hang so tren.

hard_wired_constraints: A4988 #1: MS1/MS2/MS3 (net A4988_MS11/12/13) noi cung len 5V qua via V1/V2/V5 -> CO DINH 1/16 vi buoc. Phan mem KHONG duoc cau hinh lai.
A4988 #2: MS1/MS2/MS3 (net A4988_MS21/22/23) noi cung len 5V qua via V3/V4/V6 -> CO DINH 1/16 vi buoc.
A4988: chan RST noi voi SLP -> driver luon o trang thai hoat dong, khong co ngu.
A4988: chan EN keo xuong GND -> output stage luon bat.
Hai dong co lap doi xung guong -> hai chan DIR phai o MUC NGUOC NHAU cho cung chieu di (xem khoi motor_wiring).
Nguon: pin 2S 18650 -> D1(SS34) -> U1(78M05 SMD TO252) -> 5V. VMOT lay trực tiep truoc on ap.
MPU6050 khong co chan INT noi ve MCU (header JP1x8 chi co 5V/GND/SCL/SDA) -> PHAI polling theo tick, khong duoc dung data-ready interrupt.
HC05_STATE va HC05_EN khong noi ve MCU -> khong the doc trang thai ket noi bang phan mem.
_cap_phat_timer: HAI NHAN SONG SONG, MOI NHAN MOT CACH CAP PHAT. Day khong phai mau thuan, va khong ben nao sai.

timer_allocation     = NHAN v1 (firmware/nanoos). La thu MA BO SINH MA NHAM TOI: sau ung dung trong firmware/generated/ va flow_A/flow_B deu lien ket vao nhan nay. tools/aidd_loop.py chi nhung KHOI NAY vao prompt, va tools/validate_config.py doc Timer1.freq_hz de chan tac vu xin chay o Tang 1 (cua kiem G04).

timer_allocation_v2  = NHAN v2 (firmware/nanoos_v2 + firmware/can_bang_v2). La ban DA GIU DUOC ROBOT DUNG tren phan cung that, khong cap (02/09/2026). KHONG co cong cu nao doc khoi nay - no o day de nguoi va tac nhan doc.
⚠ SUA DUNG CHO: dang viet/sinh ung dung tren nhan v1 thi doc timer_allocation. Dang viet lai firmware tu dau de robot DUNG DUOC thi doc timer_allocation_v2.

⚠ DUNG 'HOP NHAT' HAI KHOI. Doi timer_allocation sang so cua v2 se lam hong flow_A, nhan v1 va cua kiem G04 cung luc: TIER1_ISR_HZ = 20000 trong board_blk_v1.h dang duoc nanoos.c, flow_A/main.c va drv_srf04.c dung song.

⚠ GIU NGUYEN DANG dict-long-dict cho CA HAI khoi. tools/noi_dung_nanoos.py duyet .items() roi goi v.get('owner') tren tung gia tri, nen mot khoa co gia tri KIEU CHUOI dat ben trong se lam no gay. Moi ghi chu van xuoi phai nam o khoi _cap_phat_timer nay.

Timer0.use: millis()-tuong duong, dem thoi gian tho cho Tang 3

Timer1.use: Sinh xung buoc bang bo tich luy pha (muc 2.3.3)

Timer2.use: Tick 1ms cho bo lap lich cong tac

Sinh xung buoc bang BO DEM 20 us - chep dung co che cua nha san xuat. OCR2A = 16e6/8/50000 - 1 = 39. ⚠ 20 us la DON VI cua throttle: doi tan so ISR la doi don vi dau ra cua ca khau bu phi tuyen dong co.

Timer0.use: Tick 1 ms cho bo lap lich. OCR0A = 16e6/64/1000 - 1 = 249. Chu ky dieu khien hieu dung = 4 tick = 4 ms.

Timer1.use: 1 nac = 62,5 ns. Do WCET tung tac vu trong vong lap lich. De trong co chu y - khong tac vu nao duoc chiem.

delay() / delayMicroseconds() trong Tang 1 va Tang 2
phep chia (/) hoac so thuc (float/double) ben trong ISR 20kHz
doc/ghi bien nhieu byte chia se voi ISR ma khong bao ATOMIC (cli/sei)
cau hinh lai chan MS1/MS2/MS3 cua A4988 bang phan mem (da khoa cung bang jumper)
